title: Shutter Island

title: Dark City

title: eXistenZ
overview: A game designer and a marketing trainee plunge into nested layers of a virtual reality game where they can no longer be sure what is real.

title: Blade Runner 2049

overview: A programmer is invited to administer a Turing test to a captivating android, and slowly realizes he may be the one being tested and manipulated.

title: Arrival
overview: A linguist deciphering an alien language begins to experience time non-linearly, and must decide whether to embrace a future she already knows brings loss.

title: Interstellar

title: Annihilation

title: Requiem for a Dream

title: No Country for Old Men
overview: A hunter who stumbles on drug money becomes prey for an unstoppable, philosophical killer, while an aging sheriff struggles to make sense of the violence.

title: There Will Be Blood
overview: A ruthless oil prospector's ambition consumes him and everyone around him, ending in isolation and violence.

title: Nightcrawler

title: Titanic
overview: Two star-crossed lovers from different social classes fall for each other aboard the doomed Titanic, their love ending in tragedy and sacrifice.

title: Call Me by Your Name

title: Parasite

title: Snowpiercer

title: The Platform

title: Cube

title: Battle Royale

title: Children of Men

title: Get Out

title: Hereditary

title: Midsommar

title: The Thing

title: The Avengers
overview: A team of superheroes assembles to stop an alien invasion threatening Earth, trading banter as often as blows.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy
overview: A ragtag group of misfits and criminals bands together to save the galaxy, discovering they're a family along the way.

title: Deadpool
overview: A wisecracking mercenary with regenerative powers hunts down the man who disfigured him, breaking the fourth wall along the way.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
overview: A teenager becomes his universe's Spider-Man and teams up with alternate-dimension counterparts to save all of reality.

title: 10 Things I Hate About You
overview: A rebellious teen is reluctantly wooed as part of a scheme so her younger sister can date, and falls for real along the way.

title: Crazy Rich Asians

title: When Harry Met Sally

title: Superbad

title: The Hangover

title: Saving Private Ryan
overview: A squad of soldiers is sent behind enemy lines to retrieve a paratrooper whose brothers have all died in combat, at great cost to themselves.
Two young soldiers race across dangerous enemy territory to deliver a message that could save 1,600 men, including one's own brother.

title: Apocalypse Now
overview: A soldier travels upriver into the Vietnamese jungle on a mission to assassinate a renegade colonel, descending into madness along the way.

title: Unforgiven
overview: A retired gunslinger takes one last job for money, forced to confront the violent man he used to be.

title: Django Unchained

title: Heat
overview: A relentless detective and a master thief, both consumed by their work, are locked in a cat-and-mouse pursuit that can only end one way.

title: The Departed

title: Reservoir Dogs

title: The Social Network

title: Oppenheimer

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring

title: Pan's Labyrinth
overview: A young girl escapes the brutality of fascist Spain into a dark fairy-tale underworld with its own terrible tests and sacrifices.

title: Spirited Away

title: Perfect Blue

title: John Wick

title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1

title: The Martian
overview: An astronaut stranded alone on Mars must use science and sheer ingenuity to survive until a rescue can reach him.

title: Gravity

title: Contact
overview: A scientist who has spent her life searching for extraterrestrial contact gets the chance of a lifetime, and must reconcile it with what she believes.

title: Predestination

title: Whiplash
